title: Hand-pollination of vanilla
summary: Enslaved twelve-year-old Edmond Albius invented a quick way to hand-pollinate vanilla flowers with a thin stick and a thumb gesture. Nearly all vanilla is still pollinated this way.
why: Made vanilla farming possible far from its native range.

unsung.contribution: Invented the fast hand-pollination technique that made vanilla a global crop.
unsung.recognition: Attempts to win him a reward failed; a botanist falsely claimed priority; he died in poverty in 1880.
